title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-06-01
content:
Date: 2026-06-01
Time: 10:00-11:00 PT
Location: Zoom / #eng-serving-runtime
Facilitator: Ethan Park
Note taker: Priya Sharma
Attendees: Ethan Park, Priya Sharma, Lena Martinez, Owen Chen, Aria Patel, Marco Ruiz (sre), Zoe Li (infra), Ben Thompson (applied-ml), product: Maya Singh (hosted-api)

Purpose: Weekly cross-team leadership sync to align on major risks, capacity planning, rollouts, and escalations for the serving runtime and adjacent teams.

Agenda:
- Quick wins and highlights
- Incidents & reliability updates
- Capacity & Dedicated Q3 plan review
- Private deployment checklist status
- Feature rollouts (canaries, fallbacks)
- Performance optimizations and model-onboarding blockers
- Action items and next steps

1) Quick wins / highlights- Observability: New per-route latency dashboards are live in console (Lena). Early feedback is positive; product wants a short how-to for CS.- Serving runtime: Continuous batching improvements yielded ~12% token-cost reduction on long-sequence workloads in internal perf tests (Ben).- Private: First successful smoke test in customer lab for on-prem installer (Aria). Installer logs need one more cleanup pass.

2) Incidents & reliability- Incident summary: Partial KV cache corruption observed 2026-05-29 during a spike — affected ~3% of requests, automatic fallback to cold KV worked but increased latency. Root cause narrowed to race in async cache write path (Owen).- Current status: Hotfix branch ready (PR 456) — QA in progress. Target deploy to staging 2026-06-02, canary 2026-06-03.- Action: Owen + Marco to run extended load tests with fault injection to validate fixes; add additional alert on cache write errors by 2026-06-04.

3) Capacity planning (Dedicated) — Q3 commit model- Summary: Sales forecasted three medium enterprise Dedicated deals (~7x baseline GPU commit) with tentative start windows Jul-Sep. Need clear capacity plan and SLA commitments.- Discussion: Prefer soft reservations by zone and a shared burst pool to avoid stranded capacity. Autoscaler improvements required to support guaranteed burst for Dedicated customers.- Action: Zoe to deliver updated capacity spreadsheet with zone-level allocation and burst pool proposal by 2026-06-08 (linked to CONFLUENCE-1234). Engineering to review on 2026-06-10 sync.

4) Private deployments / on-prem- Status: Installer succeeding for basic topology; remaining work on KMS integration (HSM stub) and audit log upload resiliency.- Risk: Compliance customers require longer retention and offline audit export — need product decision on default retention policy.- Action: Aria + Maya to draft retention recommendation and KMS integration plan by 2026-06-07.

5) Rollouts & fallbacks- Canary cadence: Current standard (10% for 24h) is working but a recent rollback showed that some downstream clients don’t correctly handle the fallback header. Need SDK update.- Product asks for a rollout preflight checklist in Console to catch SDK compatibility issues before canary.- Action: Priya to own rollout checklist spec; sync with DevEx for SDK change by 2026-06-09.

6) Performance & model onboarding blockers- Kernel selector: There is a reproducible mismatch for certain 8-bit quantized layers causing a 1.5-2% accuracy drop for two open models. Applied-ML and Runtime must coordinate kernel tests.- Observability gap: Missing token-level breakdown for decoder-heavy models which blocks some perf tuning.- Action: Ben + Owen to run cross-bench suite with quantization variants and submit a regression report by 2026-06-05. Marco to add token-level trace to staging dashboards by 2026-06-06.

7) Cross-team asks / dependencies- Infra: Need a service account flow for Dedicated customers that integrates with cloud provider IAM — Zoe to propose approach.- SRE: Wants permission to run emergency rolling restarts for Dedicated pools — product/legal signoff needed.

8) Action items (owner — due)- Owen & Marco — run fault-injection load tests for KV cache hotfix; confirm staging results (2026-06-04)- Zoe — updated Q3 capacity spreadsheet with zone allocations and burst pool proposal (2026-06-08)- Aria & Maya — KMS/HSM integration plan + retention policy recommendation (2026-06-07)- Priya — rollout preflight checklist spec + coordinate SDK update (2026-06-09)- Ben & Owen — quantization regression report across bench suite (2026-06-05)- Marco — add token-level decoder traces to staging dashboards (2026-06-06)- Lena — short how-to doc for per-route latency dashboards for CS (2026-06-04)

Notes / open questions:- Do we want to expose cache error rates in the public console? Privacy/ops concern. (Open — product + security)- SLA language for Dedicated burst pool needs legal review (Zoe to engage Legal).

Parking lot (to discuss next week):- Autoscaler policy for multi-tenant Dedicated pools- Long-term plan for KV cache consistency model

Next meeting: 2026-06-08, 10:00 PT

Document history: initial notes taken live; will iterate and add links to PRs/alerts after meeting.
